guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 打开 Genesis Vault 并连接你的钱包
guide.description: 转到 HertzFlow Genesis Vault 页面并连接 EVM 钱包。Privy 支持的任何功能，包括 OKX 钱包、MetaMask 和 Rabby。没有邀请码，没有白名单。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Open the Genesis Vault and Connect Your Wallet
guide.original_description: Go to the HertzFlow Genesis Vault page and connect an EVM wallet. Anything supported by Privy works, including OKX Wallet, MetaMask, and Rabby. No invite code, no whitelist.

guide.title: 绑定你的钱包
guide.description: 你需要 USD1 或 U 加上一点 BNB 用于支付 Gas。稳定币可以在 Bybit 购买并直接提现到 BNB Chain。如果你的资金位于其他地方，下面的组件将跨链或交换它们。跨链资金无需离开此页面即可在 30 多个链之间进行交换和跨链。路线快，费用低。现在桥打开交互式桥组件在新标签页中打开桥
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: You need USD1 or U plus a little BNB for gas. Stablecoins can be bought on Bybit and withdrawn straight to BNB Chain. If your funds sit elsewhere, the widget below will bridge or swap them across. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 查看并接受用户协议
guide.description: 存款形式需要三项披露：智能合约风险、主网后损益暴露以及托管路径​​。存款被包装到底层 USD1 或 U 中并由 Ceffu 保管，因此请阅读它而不是点击过去。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Review and Accept the User Agreement
guide.original_description: Three disclosures gate the deposit form: smart contract risk, PnL exposure after mainnet, and the custody path. Deposits are wrapped into the underlying USD1 or U and held in Ceffu custody, so read it rather than clicking past.

guide.title: 将 USD1 或 U 存入 Genesis Vault
guide.description: 扣除手续费后至少存入 $10，然后授权并确认。持有其他代币也可以，存款会先自动换成 USD1 或 U。一旦该阶段额度满了，金库会停止接受新资金，已有存款继续计息。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Deposit USD1 or U Into the Genesis Vault
guide.original_description: Enter at least $10 after fees, then approve and confirm. Holding a different token is fine, since the deposit flow swaps into USD1 or U first. Once the phase cap fills, the vault stops taking new money while existing deposits keep running.

guide.title: 绑定你的 X 和 Discord 账号
guide.description: 可选，它不会改变存款或优点。它确实为你注册了未来的活动资格，因此你没有理由跳过。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Bind Your X and Discord Accounts
guide.original_description: Optional, and it changes nothing about deposits or Merits. It does register you for future campaign eligibility, so there is little reason to skip.

guide.title: 连续 90 天保留存款
guide.description: 提升要么全有，要么全无。持有 89 天的存款可获得基本利率；在 90 天时，通过该窗口累积的所有资金可获得 10 倍的收入。第 90 天后，提升停止增长，但基础功勋不断累积。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Hold the Deposit for 90 Continuous Days
guide.original_description: The boost is all or nothing. A deposit held 89 days earns the base rate; at 90 days it earns 10x on everything accrued over that window. After day 90 the boost stops growing, but base Merits keep accruing.

guide.title: 第 2 赛季开启后进行交易
guide.description: 一旦第 1 季的窗口关闭，永续交易将在第 2 季开启，存款人已经在抢先体验名单上。交易使用尚未推出的单独的链上推荐系统。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Perpetual trading opens in Season 2 once the Season 1 window closes, and depositors are already on the early access list. Trading uses a separate on-chain referral system that has not launched yet.

tagline_en: HertzFlow has confirmed both a token generation event and an airdrop. Official documentation describes Merits, the protocol’s reward points, as your weight in that airdrop: at TGE they convert into an allocation and reset to zero. Season 1 runs entirely through the Genesis Vault, a capped pre-deposit event where every Merit comes from supplying liquidity. Neither the allocation size nor a TGE date has been published.
